label: the dune people
note: IP-neutral. Issue #96: the home planet's native people. One people in travelling packs of 10 to 20, primitive: melee and thrown weapons only, simple sun-faded clothes, no off-world or Remnant kit. They call the Remnant 'the sky ones' and live under its thumb. They want food. Read by src/systems/natives/ (NativesDirector, PackBrain). A planet lists its packs in its own config ('natives', content/core/planets/port_desert.json); a generated planet gets packs from its type (types.json 'natives', with a people template like desert_folk.json). Draft content: the product owner edits freely.

standard.note: The leader's pole with a rag on top, so a pack can be seen coming from far off.

weapons.note: Melee and thrown only: slings and bows are too hard to come by in the desert, and Remnant rifles are never their kit. The first melee weapon is the chief's (the chief never throws). 'move' is the NativeMoves swing a melee weapon plays. A rock is a small, short, dark bolt with no glow and no sound ('matte', 'length', 'radius', 'sfx').

camp.note: A pack's camp (NativeCamp): 'tents' hide tents in a ring 'ring_m' out from an always-lit firepit, each a room (rug, rock table and seats, bedroll, a chest). The pack starts there, stops 'stop_s' seconds on every loop of its route, and comes in for the night (the hour from 'night_from' to 'night_to'). 'keepers' of them never leave it and fight only within 'guard_m' of it. Shoot a tent 'tent_hp' and it falls in; all of them down and the camp is back 'return_hours' in-game hours later (in-game time runs 'game_hours_per_real_min' hours a real minute, and a night's rest skips to morning). A chest holds 'loot_rolls' draws from 'loot' (what the town's traders and fences buy) and fills again 'restock_hours' after it is emptied. Take from it while one of the pack sees you and a friendly pack turns on you. The camp goes on the flattest ground within 'site_search_m' of where it is put. A pack's own 'camp' (the planet's data) gives where ('at', a map point) and after which route point it stops ('stop_after'), and may change any of these.

rest.note: [Z] in a friendly pack's standing tent: the screen fades to black, you heal, the time of day moves on to 'morning_hour', the game is saved, the screen fades back.

trade.note: Packs only take food. Food is cheap in town (the food stall at the market); quartz sells there. An adults-only pack throws in a little more.

hostile.note: A hostile pack attacks on sight and fights to the last. Survive survive_s seconds without killing any of them (and without being downed) and they stop, offer trade, and the pack turns friendly. Kill one and that pack never will.

voice.note: Never spoken aloud (the soldier block's 'voiced' is false): yells show over their heads, and the gestures are NativeMoves with these as captions.
voice.gesture_offer: (the leader mimes eating, then holds out a fistful of quartz)
voice.gesture_thanks: (they touch their foreheads and press the quartz into your hand)
voice.gesture_no_food: (the leader rubs its belly and shakes its head: no food, no quartz)
voice.gesture_truce: (they lower their weapons and the leader mimes eating, palms open)

lines.traded: Traded 1 food for %d quartz with the %s. Reputation %d.
lines.horn: A battle horn! The %s are coming for you.
lines.survive: SURVIVE  %d:%02d   (do not kill any of them)
lines.won: The %s lower their weapons. They will trade with you now.
lines.locked: You killed one of the %s. They will never forgive it.
lines.prompt_chest: [E]  Take what is in the chest
lines.seen_stealing: The %s saw you steal from them!
lines.camp_wrecked: The %s's camp is torn down. They will put it back up.
lines.rested: You wake rested. It is morning.
